title: Quam pulchra es (C. Festa)
desc: Costanzo Festa, Quam pulchra es. 4 voices (Superius, Superius II, Altus, Tenor), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
